notes: Modified cash basis school district, year ended Aug 31, 2025. Governmental receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column of the statement on pp5-6 (after Eliminations). Interfund transfers among governmental funds (770,000: 700,000 to Depreciation, 70,000 to Activity) are eliminated in that column, so transfers_in is null; Transfer to Nutrition Fund 210,000 is a transfer_out (inside printed total disbursements 7,009,728, hence includes transfers_out) and equals business-type transfer in. Roll-forward: 4,849,455 + 8,137,632 - 6,799,728 - 210,000 = 5,977,359. Beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balances (cash basis; ties to balance sheet p4). Interest income 133,727 split using the General and Building budget schedules (penalties and interest on taxes 8,863 + 2,128 to property tax). Business-type = Nutrition Fund (pp7-8): beginning 46,334 + receipts 134,957 - disbursements 274,422 + transfer 210,000 = 116,869. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position total column (p1; component unit excluded). Detail: General Fund revenue from the budget schedule (p9) and General Fund spending by program and object from the Schedules of Cash Disbursements (pp13-17; supersedes the function-only budget schedule disbursements, not recorded to avoid double counting); lines with actual '-' (zero) and 'Adjust to budget form' lines were skipped. Hidden transfers: General Fund Instruction, Facility improvements and Pupil transportation lines contain 700,000 transferred to the Depreciation Fund (eliminated on p6; Depreciation Fund shows transfer from General Fund 700,000 on p10); contra lines and an other financing line record this. Transfers to Activity 70,000 and Nutrition 210,000 are other financing lines. The printed General Fund total 6,361,636 includes the 280,000 of transfers; two program subtotals in the printed schedule do not add (see report_discrepancies). Activity Fund has no schedule (statement figures only). Depreciation and Building Fund expenditures from their budget schedules; other governmental funds from the combining statement p12 (Total ties to p6). Read pages 1-17 of 17
